requirements.description: Add search filters allowing users to narrow results by category and city
requirements.label: existing_configuration

tasks.task: Configure URL routing to enable category and city query parameters for the search page
tasks.assumption: Platform version supports adding query‑string filters without code changes

tasks.task: Add UI controls (dropdowns) for category and city on the search results page and bind them to the configured URL parameters
tasks.assumption: Existing theme allows insertion of simple UI widgets

tasks.task: Populate category dropdown from the existing taxonomy and city dropdown from the configured city list/content
tasks.assumption: Categories and city data are already maintained in the CMS

tasks.task: Perform functional testing (filter combinations, empty states) and cross‑browser verification
tasks.assumption: No custom JavaScript conflicts on the page

requirements.description: Streamline the member addition process to reduce manual admin effort
requirements.label: needs_clarification

tasks.task: Gather detailed requirements and design the streamlined member addition workflow (including bulk import and email invitation options).
tasks.assumption: Stakeholders can provide clear acceptance criteria within a short session.

tasks.task: Develop bulk member import feature: CSV upload UI, validation, and backend processing to create members.
tasks.assumption: Platform already has an API for member creation and supports file uploads.

tasks.task: Implement email invitation workflow: generate invitation links, send templated emails, and handle acceptance flow.
tasks.assumption: SMTP/email service is configured and the platform can store pending invitations.

tasks.task: Update admin UI to surface the new streamlined member addition options (bulk import button, invite button, status feedback).
tasks.assumption: The admin UI is built with a component framework that allows easy addition of new screens/buttons.

tasks.task: Perform functional testing, edge‑case validation, and create documentation for admins on the new process.
tasks.assumption: Test environment mirrors production and QA resources are available.

requirements.description: Implement a monthly newsletter that is sent only to members who have opted in
requirements.label: existing_limited

tasks.task: Analyze existing opt‑in tracking implementation and define data source for newsletter eligibility
tasks.assumption: Opt‑in data is stored in a searchable field accessible via the platform's ORM

tasks.task: Create/extend admin UI for newsletter content creation and management (template editor, subject line, preview)
tasks.assumption: Platform provides a generic form builder that can be leveraged for the newsletter editor

tasks.task: Develop a scheduled background job (cron / task runner) that runs monthly, pulls opted‑in members, and queues emails via the existing email service integration
tasks.assumption: An email service SDK (e.g., SendGrid, Mailgun) is already configured and can be called from server code

tasks.task: Add configuration settings for newsletter schedule (day of month, time) and enable/disable toggle in admin panel
tasks.assumption: Platform has a central configuration store that can be extended without code deployment

tasks.task: End‑to‑end testing: verify opt‑in filtering, email rendering, delivery, unsubscribe handling, and schedule accuracy
tasks.assumption: A staging environment with email capture (sandbox mode) is available for testing

requirements.description: Fix the mobile homepage layout so the menu does not overlap the logo and looks good on phones
requirements.label: needs_clarification

tasks.task: Inspect current homepage markup and CSS to locate the styles causing the menu to overlap the logo on small viewports
tasks.assumption: The homepage uses standard HTML/CSS and we have developer access to view and edit the source files.

tasks.task: Create or modify responsive CSS (media queries) to reposition the menu and logo for mobile widths, ensuring no overlap and visual consistency
tasks.assumption: The site uses a CSS framework (e.g., Bootstrap, Foundation) that can be extended with custom media queries.

tasks.task: Perform cross‑device testing on a set of representative phones (iPhone SE, Pixel, Galaxy) and browser developer tools to verify the layout works correctly
tasks.assumption: Testing can be done using emulator tools and a small pool of physical devices.

tasks.task: Document the CSS changes, update any related style guides, and deploy the updated assets to the staging environment for final QA
tasks.assumption: The deployment pipeline is already set up and requires only a simple asset push.
